translation.name: In yancuic mononotzalistli ica Totecohtzin Jesucristo

book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: IN TLAHCUILOLAMATL ICA INOHQUE AQUIN QUINTOCAHHUIYAHQUE IN HEBREOHTECOS

content: Ocachi yihuehcau in Dios oquinmonextililo ica in tochichicacoluan yolic huan cuali, quemaniyan ica tlahtoli huan quemaniyan ica oc sequin tlachiuten. Yeh in intequiu inohque tetlayolchicaucahuan in Dios.

Huan ic inin tonalten ic tlamis in tlalticpac, techmonextilihtoc san secpa ica seya aquin nele ijcon quen Dios, huan yeh in Iconetzin Jesús. Yehhuatzin in aquin oquimomaquili nochin tlen oncan, tleca ica Yehhuatzin omochihualoc Dios nochin tlen oncan.

Mopiya in tetlamachilis in Dios, huan ic inon moteixmatiltiya ica tehueyilistzin in Dios, Yehhuatzin Jesús in aquin mochicautoc nochin tlen oncan ica tetlahtol chicahuac. Huan satepa ic oquixtlapacholoc ica totlahtlacol, omotlaliloc ic teyejcan in Dios ipan neluicac.
In Iconetzin in Dios ocachi yolihuatoc quen in ángeles
Ica tlen omochiu in Iconetzin Dios, ocachi yolihuatoc quen in ángeles, huan moselihtoc ocachi mahuestic tetoca quen in ángeles.
In Dios otenotz teconeu, quen omoluic:

content.text: Tehhuatl nele tinoconeu;
nehhuatl nimitzixmatiltihtoc axan quen noconeu.

content: Ahyic ijcon omihto ica niyan se ángel:

content.text: Nimochihuas tetata ica yehhuatl,
huan ijcon omoluic in Teconetzin.

content: Huan ihcuac omoteixmatilti nican tlalticpac in Tetiachicau ica nochin tlacatl, omihto:

content.text: Matemahuestilican nochin in ángeles den neluicac.
Quemaniyan niquinmochihuili in noángeles mayecan quen yehyecamen, ic nechpalehuiyahque,
huan quemaniyan niquinmochihuili quen itleyo in tletl.
Oh Dios, tetequihuahyou nochipa yes,
huan ic tlatequiutilos nochipa tlamelajcan.
Huan momahuestilihtoc in tlen tlamelajcan, huan mixtlastoc in tlen ahmo cuali.
Ic inon nehhuatl aquin moDios onimitzmacac ocachi hueyi tequisca quen ica in oc sequinten tenonotzcahuan huan ijcon mopaquilohtoc molui.
Huan axan, Totecohtzin, de achto mochiutoc in tlalticpactli,
huan ica teman omochiu in neluicactli.
Yehhuan tlamisque, huan Tehhuatzin mocahualos nochipa.
Huan nochten yehhuan mochihuasque ocachi yichihchicahuaque quen in tatapahtli yitlantoc.
Moixpostequisque quen se tlaquemitl huan mopatlasque quen tatapahtli.
Huan Tehhuatzin san nochipa mocahualos,
huan tenemilis ahyic tlamis.

content: In Dios ahyic omoluic niyan seya den ángeles quen omoluic ica Yehhuatzin:

content.text: Ximotlali noyejcan,
ihcuac niquintlalis mocxitla in motecocolihcahuan.

content: Nochin in ángeles san yehyecamen ic tepalehuiyahque in Dios, tlatitlanilten ic quimpalehuisque in aquihque quiselisque in temaquixtilistli.
